_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 object handlers: ground enemies $0E and $0F ($9A5C-$9C1C). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): first frame?
regions.description: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): bit 7 set goes to `$9AA7`. Stats of the type: hit points 4, attack 8 (both replaced from the tier tables), flags 0, drawing flags 3, art block `$14`, dies as type 8. Enemy strength is chosen by the AREA TIER `($50 + 1) / 2` (0 for area 0, 1 for areas 1-2, 2 for 3-4, 3 for 5-6, 4 for 7-8, 5 for 9-10), not by `$FE88`.

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): placed already?
regions.description: `$0728` (the hit box bottom) non-zero means a spawner gave a position.

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): random placement
regions.description: `JSR $C0F3` (`$FA17`: a random x of 32-223 and y of 40-183) and `JSR $9A53` (is the cell under it blocking?): a blocked cell goes to `$9B17`, which removes it and, unless its drawing flags have bit 4, restores the type from `$0740` so it picks another place next frame.

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): art wait
regions.description: `JSR $C0A8`.

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): first move
regions.description: `$0680,X` (the turn countdown) := 1.

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): set-up
regions.description: `JSR $C0A2`.

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): picture
regions.description: Metasprite `$3C`.

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): the tier
regions.description: `JSR $9B0F`: Y := the area tier.

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): palette and speed class by tier
regions.description: `$0560` := `$9ADB[tier]` (`00 00 00 01 02 03`) and `$0698` := `$9AE1[tier]` (`01 02 02 02 03 41`). RUN: spawned in the labyrinth state with `$0728` preset (to skip the random placement) at areas 0, 3 and 9.

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): turn interval and attack by tier
regions.description: `$0668` := `$9AE7[tier]` (`40 30 20 20 10 08`, the base number of frames between turns) and `$05A8` := `$9AED[tier]` (`04 08 10 20 30 50`).

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): hit points by tier
regions.description: `$0590` := `$9AF3[tier]` (`01 02 06 0C 18 30`). RUN: area 0: class 1, interval 64, attack 4, hit points 1; area 3: 2, 32, 16, 6; area 9: `$41`, 8, 80, 48.

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): introduction
regions.description: `$0788` := `$28`: 40 frames of flickering arrival.

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): every frame: introduction, picture
regions.description: `JSR $C009` (`$FD53`): while `$0788` counts down the object is drawn only on every second frame and the rest of the handler is skipped (no movement, no hits); then the wing animation `$9AF9` with step `$40`.

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): the turn countdown
regions.description: `$0680,X` is decremented; non-zero keeps the direction.

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): choose a new direction
regions.description: A random number: `$0680` := (random AND `$3F`) + `$0668` (frames until the next turn) and the direction := random AND `$0F` through `$C102`. RUN: the area 9 enemy changed direction about every 8-70 frames and covered x 48-183, y 4-127; the area 0 enemy x 128-159, y 100-127.

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): move
regions.description: `JSR $9B2A`.

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): turn at a wall
regions.description: A blocking class under it (`$8425`) sets `$0680` := 1: a new direction next frame.

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): hit test
regions.description: `JSR $C0C6` (mask `$30`).

regions.name: TYPE $0E (A WANDERING GROUND ENEMY): resolve
regions.description: `JMP $C0D2`.

regions.name: Type $0E palette by area tier
Type $0E speed class by area tier
Type $0E turn interval by area tier
Types $0E and $0F attack by area tier
Types $0E and $0F hit points by area tier
Two-picture flip animation
regions.description: `JSR $C0A5` with step A over 2 phases; on every wrap the horizontal flip bit `$40` of the palette `$0560` is toggled: the enemy faces left, right, left.

regions.name: Flip bit 6 of the palette when (`$41` AND A) = 0 (`$9B09`)
regions.description: `AND $41 / BEQ $9B00 / BNE $9B08`: enters the flip at `$9B00` (palette bit 6 toggled, the horizontal flip) when the frame counter ANDed with A is 0. **CORRECTION: this was listed as an unreferenced fragment. It has one caller, `JSR $9B09` at `$9D9E` (A = 3), in the `$1D`-`$1F` handler's branch for type `$73`. **CORRECTION OF THE CORRECTION: that branch is live - type `$73`'s own handler (`$B96E`) jumps into it - so the call is made every frame by type `$73`.**

regions.name: The area tier (`$9B0F`)
regions.description: Y := (`$50` + 1) / 2: 0 for area 0, 1 for areas 1-2, 2 for 3-4, 3 for 5-6, 4 for 7-8, 5 for 9-10. The tier tables of the ordinary enemies are indexed by it.

regions.name: Try again, or give up
regions.description: The drawing flags are kept; the object is removed (`$C048`, which saves its type in `$0740`); if the flags had bit 4 clear the type is restored from `$0740` so it is made again next frame.

regions.name: Enemy move (`$9B2A`), labyrinth
regions.description: In the labyrinth (`$30` bit 6 clear): `JSR $826D` (the player's move with wall sliding; `$6C-$6F` are the cell classes) and `JSR $C090` (draw).

regions.name: Enemy move, corridor
regions.description: `$6C` := 0 (no cells); drawing flags bit 4 set goes to the alternative; else `JSR $C08D` (move and draw); carry (left the screen) removes it through `$9B17`.

regions.name: Enemy move, bit-4 form
regions.description: `JSR $9B53` (move and draw); an object that did not survive returns from the caller as well.

regions.name: Move and draw
regions.description: `JSR $C08D`, RTS.

regions.name: TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): first frame?
regions.description: TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): bit 7 set goes to `$9BA9`. Stats of the type: hit points 4, attack 10 (replaced), flags 0, drawing flags 3, art block `$13`, dies as type 8.

regions.name: TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): placed already?
regions.description: `$0728` non-zero.

regions.name: TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): random placement
regions.description: As type `$0E`: a random free cell or try again.

regions.name: TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): art wait
regions.description: `JSR $C0A8`.

regions.name: TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): speed class, picture
TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): the tier
regions.description: `JSR $9B0F`.

regions.name: TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): palette and rest time by tier
regions.description: `$0560` := `$9C0D[tier]` (`02 01 01 02 03 00`), `$07A0` := `$9C13[tier]` (`50 3C 28 14 0A 01`: frames at rest, 80 down to 1). RUN: spawned in the labyrinth state with `$0728` preset (to skip the random placement) at areas 0, 3 and 9.

regions.name: TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): attack by tier
TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): hit points by tier
regions.description: `$0590` := `$9AF3[tier]` (the same as type `$0E`).

regions.name: TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): introduction and phase
regions.description: `$0788` := `$28`, the phase countdown `$0668` := 1, `JSR $C0A2`, the phase `$0680` := 0.

regions.name: TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): every frame: introduction
TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): the phase countdown
regions.description: `$0668` is decremented; non-zero skips to the picture.

regions.name: TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): next phase
TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): how long the phase lasts
regions.description: Phase 0 (rest): `$07A0` frames (`$9C19[0]` = 80 if that is 0); phases 1, 2, 3: `$9C19[phase]` = 40, 20, 20 frames.

regions.name: TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): phase 2: the lunge
regions.description: Only at the start of phase 2.

regions.name: TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): aim and go
regions.description: `JSR $C0FF` (the direction to the player) plus a random 0-3, AND `$0C`: one of the four straight directions (right, down, left, up), through `$C102`. The speed class is 3. RUN: over 400 frames the area 0 enemy covered x 128-150, y 71-100 and the area 3 one y 43-100: short straight lunges (about 30 px) with long rests.

regions.name: TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): picture
regions.description: Outside the rest phase a two-picture animation (`$C0A5`, step `$60`) whose tile offset is 2 x the phase.

regions.name: TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): draw or move
regions.description: Phase 2 moves (`$9B2A`, with wall sliding); the other phases only draw (`$C090`).

regions.name: TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): the move
regions.description: `JSR $9B2A`.

regions.name: TYPE $0F (A RESTING ENEMY THAT LUNGES): hit test and resolve
regions.description: `JSR $C0C6`, `JMP $C0D2`.

regions.name: Type $0F palette by area tier
Type $0F rest time by area tier
Type $0F phase lengths
regions.description: `50 28 14 14` (index = phase; phase 0 normally uses the rest time instead).
